sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment 
inspection I2, which should be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in 
the title block.

GRF
supply flue gases at furnace bottom to control reheat outlet temperature and to 
reduce NOX. pollution

The first draft initiated by eng. Kamel Abd El-Salem Abd 
El-Rahman , tested by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Eid, accepted by general manager 
eng. Al Sayed Mohamed Ahmed Al Tair, approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel Hafez Al-Sharedy: 
head sector of Cairo West Power Station,

This document revised by eng Nageh Soliman 
 Shousha CEPC inspection and 
 quality control director, certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib CEPC inspection & quality control's 
 Head Sector, MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, ....etc.
Fan should be out of service.
Disconnect the circuit breaker of the fans motor.

sections.text:
Alignment Procedures 
see figure 1.
Dismantle and remove the coupling spacer.

Mount the dial indicators 
one at the axial direction and one on the radial direction both on half coupling 
motor side (fixed part).

Adjust the indicator 
pointer to zero reading.

Rotate the fan on the 
CWD and record the initial reading for axial and radial direction.

Loose the motor mounting 
bolts and jack bolts.

According to the initial 
reading shims to be added or removed under the motor legs to adjust the reading 
to the accepted limits.

Tighten the motor mounting 
bolts and jack bolt.

Take a final reading for 
the alignment check in the radial and axial direction.

Reassemble the coupling 
spacer.
Put the fan in operation.

Check the vibration using 
the vibro-meter.
